payout_quote: CRV charged for beverages sold in aluminum, glass, plastic containers, and bimetal containers is: 5¢ for each beverage container less than 24 ounces / 10¢ for each container 24 ounces or more / 25¢ regardless of size for Wine or Distilled Spirits sold in bag-in-box, multilayer pouch, paperboard carton, or plastic pouch containers (Effective January 1, 2024)
steps: Buy eligible CRV-labeled beverages in California (5¢/10¢ CRV is itemized on your receipt)
Save the empty CA CRV-labeled containers
Find a certified recycling center via CalRecycle's Recycling Centers search page
Bring containers (up to 50 at a time you may request payment by count) and receive the CRV refund in cash
catches: This returns YOUR OWN deposit money paid at purchase — it is recovering your own money, not new income.
Only containers bought in-state with the correct deposit label are redeemable; out-of-state containers are ineligible and redeeming them is fraud.
Certified recyclers may pay by weight at state-set minimum per-pound rates instead of by count for large loads; recyclers may refuse or discount contaminated materials.
biggest_catch: This returns your own CRV deposit — you paid it at checkout. It is deposit recovery, not income.
eligibility: California resident/visitor who purchased CRV-labeled beverages in California; containers must carry the CA CRV label.
timing: Refund paid at the recycling center at time of redemption.

c1.evidence: CalRecycle is the California state agency administering the Beverage Container Recycling Program; terms page is on calrecycle.ca.gov.

c2.evidence: Official CalRecycle page posts CRV rates: 5¢ under 24 oz, 10¢ at 24+ oz, 25¢ for wine/spirits pouches.

c3.evidence: No fee to redeem; CRV was already paid at purchase.

c4.evidence: Refund paid in cash at certified recycling centers; consumers redeeming ≤50 containers may demand payment by count.

s1.note: Anyone who bought CRV-labeled beverages in California.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: buy labeled beverages, save empties, visit certified center, get cash.

notes: Deposit-recovery framing; CA CRV is a distributor fee passed through to consumers.
payout_value_note: Official per-container CRV: 5¢ (<24 oz), 10¢ (24+ oz), 25¢ (wine/spirits pouches).
numeric_basis: payout from official CalRecycle terms (5¢/10¢/25¢ per container); time: collecting/bagging containers plus a redemption-center trip est. 30–60 min active.
